# CONF-016: Deprecated logging capability is declared

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/deprecated#deprecated](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/deprecated#deprecated) |

Reads the capabilities from server/discover. Logging is deprecated as of 2026-07-28 (SEP-2577) and new implementations SHOULD NOT adopt it. Roots and sampling are also deprecated; they are client features and are checked when the MRTR checks land.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-016`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-016"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
